ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, the mass of an elevator is M, and an object of mass m is placed on its horizontal floor. Under the pulling force of the steel cable, the elevator moves vertically upward with acceleration. When the elevator's speed increases from $v_1$ to $v_2$, the rising height is H. Then during this process, which of the following statements or expressions is correct? (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The mass of the elevator is M, and an object of mass m is placed on its horizontal floor. Under the action of the tension of the steel cable, the elevator accelerates vertically upward. When the speed of the elevator increases from $v_1$ to $v_2$, the rising height is H. In this process, what expression can be written by applying the kinetic energy theorem to this object? (Assume the work done by the supporting force is $W_{\mathrm{N}}$)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows an elevator car suspended by a steel cable, with a small object placed on the horizontal floor inside the elevator, and the object moves together with the elevator. Then reason: In the ground reference frame, apply the kinetic energy theorem to the object of mass m. The object moves vertically upward with the elevator through displacement H, and its speed increases from v_1 to v_2. The object is subject to two forces: the floor's supporting force N upward, and gravity mg downward. The problem states that the work done by the supporting force is W_N; the direction of gravity is opposite to the direction of displacement, so the work done by gravity is -mgH. The work done by the resultant force equals the change in kinetic energy, therefore there is W_N - mgH = (1/2)mv_2^2 - (1/2)mv_1^2.

method.method_draft: 直接对物体在地面参考系中列动能定理。先从图中确认物体放在电梯水平地板上，随电梯一起竖直向上位移 H；对该物体受力分析：地板支持力 N 向上，重力 mg 向下。支持力做功题中记为 W_N；重力与位移反向，做功为 -mgH。由合外力做功等于动能变化，得到 W_N - mgH = 1/2 m v_2^2 - 1/2 m v_1^2。

method.method_draft: 从牛顿第二定律的微分形式推导功—能关系。取竖直向上为正，对物体有 N - mg = ma。将等式两边乘以微小位移 dy，并沿电梯上升过程积分：∫N dy - ∫mg dy = ∫ma dy。左边第一项就是支持力做功 W_N，第二项为 mgH；右边利用 a dy = v dv，得 ∫m v dv = 1/2 m v_2^2 - 1/2 m v_1^2。因此得到 W_N - mgH = 1/2 m v_2^2 - 1/2 m v_1^2。
